title: Nvidia released its 8800 GTX GPU 20 years ago today, celebrates with Steam game homage
content: On this day in 2006, Nvidia released the legendary GeForce 8800 GTX graphics card and it is celebrating the event with a very demanding (but free) interactive Steam demo.

title: Two Chinese companies cleared to buy banned Nvidia AI chips have empty offices and unknown addresses
content: The offices for New Matrix and Maginfra, both approved to receive H200 chips, appear abandoned, and people in the buildings say they're unfamiliar with the companies or have never seen anyone working there.

title: PC's with 64GB of RAM plummet 18% as memory prices soar
content: CPU-Z data reveals PC memory capacity is dropping for the first time ever. Driven by skyrocketing AI DRAM prices, 64GB RAM adoption plummeted 18% YoY.

title: Homelabber uses second-gen Optane memory sticks to run a 2.8-trillion-parameter AI model on CPU alone
content: A Reddit homelab user ran Moonshot AI’s 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 CPU-only on Optane PMem 200 at 0.85 tokens/s with a 1-bit quant.
